comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
There are 2 requirements to get this recipe to show at the farms:

1) Farm(as opposed to Mine, Fishery or Ranch) technological development level at(I believe) minimum 500

2) At least 1 Farm plot able to produce Large Leaves

It's been a few years, so my information may be shaky or out of date regarding the Farm technological development level(it may be more or less), but I'm almost positive about 1 plot being able to produce Large Leaves.

IGN: CullumStraun
